noise_band.rule: candidate record not worse than the baseline record by more than 2 win(s) on a 128-map pool (tolerance = ceil(128 * 1/70) = 2; measured: three different binaries all recorded 58-12 on the 70-map pool)
noise_band.derivation: measured: three different binaries all recorded 58-12 on the 70-map pool, so binary-change noise on the RECORD is <= 1 win per 70 maps; tolerance = ceil(pool_size * 1/70)
